raw_response:
Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with a contralateral mediastinal shift (trachea and heart displaced to the right), which is the classic radiographic appearance of a massive pleural effusion rather than lung collapse (which would cause an ipsilateral shift). Among the choices, a large pleural effusion causing contralateral displacement is best described by option A.
